description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Snow], [Frost Sanction Damage Tracker] and [Frost Sanction Level]

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Snow
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Frost Sanction (0~2), removed after using Frost Sanction two times

description.name: Frost Sanction Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Frost Sanction level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Snow]

description.name: Frost Sanction Level
description.text: Keeps track of Frost Sanction level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Snow]
